role_summary: Own Q6/Q7 by designing the Markdown-to-SQLite pipeline, choosing the source of truth, handling revisions, and unifying evidence gaps across all eight crops.
recommendation: Make reviewed, version-controlled JSONL the operational source of truth; retain Markdown and the registry as hashed provenance inputs, and compile SQLite as an immutable release artifact. Use deterministic parsing only for structural harvesting, with optional pinned LLM candidate generation and mandatory human approval. Retire the six-crop registry after migrating it into uniform eight-crop coverage records.
why: Verified across all files: each has the same 11 H2 boundaries, but only the six 254-line documents share seven table layouts and five structured sources. Basil has 40 H3s and 16 sources; peppermint has 24 H3s and 10.

Basil and peppermint use bullet-form basic information, narrative research blocks, and differing table columns; basil also has an extra section-7 gap table. Semantic extraction is therefore not safely deterministic.
Reviewed JSONL prevents parser or LLM guesses from becoming evidence while hashes, source spans, and Git commits preserve auditability to the Korean originals.
One per-crop coverage model removes the registry’s six-versus-two split without discarding its status vocabulary or provenance.
schema_sketch:
CORPUS FINDING
- Safe to parse deterministically: the 10 numbered H2 sections, trailing summary, GFM tables, fenced blocks, and section-10 source records. Every section-10 source uses the same nine labels.
- Unsafe to interpret deterministically: numeric meaning, evidence class, applicability, and fact-to-source linkage. Values occur in prose and nested lists, recur in summaries, and may be an optimum, trial condition, disease-risk condition, or explicit absence.

CANONICAL INTERMEDIATE
One reviewed JSONL record per fact, coverage assessment, or guidance item:
{
  "record_id": "coverage:basil:air.relative_humidity.growth_optimum",
  "revision_id": "sha256:...",
  "record_kind": "coverage",
  "crop_id": "basil",
  "item_key": "air.relative_humidity.growth_optimum",
  "coverage_state": "searched_none",
  "evidence_class": null,
  "status_codes": ["no_direct_evidence"],
  "detail_ko": "바질 생육 최적 RH를 검증한 범용 직접자료 미확인",
  "sources": [{
    "artifact_sha256": "...",
    "locator": {"section":"2. 대기 환경","table_row":"적정 상대습도","line_start":93,"line_end":93},
    "raw_span_sha256": "..."
  }],
  "review": {"decision":"approved","curator":"...","reviewed_at":"..."}
}
A separate fact may represent RH >=85% as evidence_class=disease_risk; it must not fill the growth-optimum coverage record.

PIPELINE
1. Snapshot every Markdown file and the registry using Git commit, path, SHA-256, UTF-8 line count, and format version.
2. Parse with a pinned GFM AST parser. Emit lossless candidate blocks/cells with section, block index, row label, lines, raw text, and span hash. Reject missing/reordered required H2 sections, but permit registered table variants.
3. Apply controlled item aliases and numeric tokenization only to propose candidates. An LLM may propose mappings, but its model ID, prompt hash, parameters, and response hash are logged; it cannot approve records.
4. A curator assigns stable item keys, evidence class, coverage state, status codes, scope, source links, and guidance. JSON Schema validation forbids numeric values on searched_none records.
5. Registry migration: import its 114 crop-specific gaps and 26 limited-evidence entries as candidates using JSON pointers. Treat its nine common gaps as six-crop candidates requiring per-crop confirmation; never copy them automatically to basil or peppermint. Curate those two from their tables, explicit inline markers, and the same item catalogue.
6. CI fails when an input hash changes without a reviewed intermediate revision. Changed records receive new revision IDs; stable record IDs remain. Withdrawn records are omitted from the new release, never deleted from history.
7. Build SQLite from sorted, schema-valid JSONL. A release selects exact record revisions; SQLite is never edited manually. Compare logical content-manifest hashes rather than binary database hashes across SQLite versions.

DDL FOR INGESTION, RELEASES, AND GAP UNIFICATION
PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

CREATE TABLE knowledge_release (
  release_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_git_commit TEXT NOT NULL,
  curated_git_commit TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  curated_manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  pipeline_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  sqlite_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  release_time TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(source_manifest_sha256, curated_manifest_sha256, schema_version, pipeline_version)
);

CREATE TABLE source_artifact_revision (
  artifact_revision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  artifact_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(artifact_kind IN ('crop_markdown','gap_registry')),
  source_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  crop_id TEXT,
  git_commit TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  format_version TEXT,
  utf8_line_count INTEGER CHECK(utf8_line_count >= 0),
  UNIQUE(source_path, content_sha256)
);

CREATE TABLE extraction_run (
  extraction_run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  artifact_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_artifact_revision,
  extractor_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(extractor_kind IN ('gfm_structure','rules','llm_candidate')),
  extractor_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  model_id TEXT,
  prompt_sha256 TEXT,
  response_sha256 TEXT,
  candidate_manifest_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE source_span (
  span_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  artifact_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_artifact_revision,
  locator_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(locator_kind IN ('markdown_block','markdown_table_row','json_pointer')),
  locator_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(locator_json)),
  raw_span_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  raw_text_ko TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE evidence_coverage_revision (
  coverage_revision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  coverage_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  supersedes_revision_id TEXT REFERENCES evidence_coverage_revision,
  crop_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  item_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  coverage_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(coverage_state IN ('not_reviewed','searched_none','limited','direct')),
  detail_ko TEXT NOT NULL,
  curator TEXT NOT NULL,
  reviewed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  canonical_record_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE evidence_status_code (
  status_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY
);

CREATE TABLE coverage_status (
  coverage_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_coverage_revision,
  status_code TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_status_code,
  PRIMARY KEY (coverage_revision_id, status_code)
);

CREATE TABLE coverage_source (
  coverage_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_coverage_revision,
  span_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_span,
  PRIMARY KEY (coverage_revision_id, span_id)
);

CREATE TABLE release_coverage (
  release_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_release,
  coverage_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES evidence_coverage_revision,
  PRIMARY KEY (release_id, coverage_revision_id),
  UNIQUE (release_id, coverage_revision_id)
);

-- The fact schema may be normalized separately, but every fact revision should
-- participate in the same release and source-span mechanism.
CREATE TABLE release_fact (
  release_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_release,
  fact_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (release_id, fact_revision_id)
);
assumptions: Git history remains available, and a curator can review every changed candidate before release.
The team can agree on stable item keys and a JSON Schema early enough to avoid repeated remapping.
risks: Human review may become the bottleneck, especially when narrative-heavy documents are extensively rewritten.
The intermediate and Markdown can drift if the hash gate is bypassed or emergency database edits are allowed.
Stable record IDs may be assigned inconsistently; line locators also become useless unless paired with immutable artifact and span hashes.
cheap_validation: Run one 45-minute spike over basil section 2, peppermint section 3, and lettuce section 5: harvest and curate 20 records, build SQLite twice, and require identical logical manifest hashes plus exact source spans for all 20; any missing provenance, changed output, or conflated basil RH fact kills the proposal.
change_mind_if: I would abandon reviewed sidecars as the operational source of truth if a corpus-wide GFM round trip proves that every fact, gap, evidence class, applicability qualifier, and source link is already represented by stable keyed machine-readable fields in all eight Markdown files.
